g.text: Overview page: a status page that reads two APIs
Internal only, no login. A small Caddy serves the page and proxies exactly two read-only things.
Why a proxy, not the metric UI: that host sits
behind Authentik ForwardAuth, and a page cannot
finish a login redirect inside a background fetch.
Without the Proxmox token the page still works:
the Proxmox slide just does not appear.
Reachability badges on the app icons are the
browser's own no-cors fetch: "can I open this
Accepted cost: anyone on the LAN can run PromQL against cluster telemetry through this page.
Sources: docs/services/overview.md. The status.xiiisins.com alias is not public: no Cloudflare record and no tunnel rule.
